crime: For half a year, her closest friend had come to every pot of herbal tea {WITCH_NAME} brewed, accepting every small kindness. This week the friend began carrying her own tray and mending her own clothes. That morning she refused the offered cup. “I'll brew my own after today.”
{WITCH_NAME} dug up a poisonous root and steeped it with the afternoon herbs. She served each girl a cup by hand; her friend poured her own. By nightfall the friend was dead. Everyone else was well.

The girls suspected poison in the friend's cup, but they had watched her fill it from their common pot. Comparing accounts, they found that the only girl to die was the one who had served herself. {WITCH_NAME} alone had gathered and brewed the herbs. Her magic had made the poisoned tea safe each time she handed a cup to someone.
fields.epitaph: She held them all up, and no one thought to carry her.
fields.epithet: The Girl Built Into Every Wall
execution: A stone arch stood with its keystone missing. An iron yoke fastened around her shoulders fitted into the gap. The side supports were withdrawn one by one, leaving the arch's weight on her. When her knees buckled, the stones collapsed onto her.

magic.name: Wholesome Hand
magic.text: Food or drink she hands to someone becomes harmless to that person.
